provenance.paper: Process Mining: Data Science in Action
provenance.citation: van der Aalst, W.M.P. (2016). Process Mining: Data Science in Action. Springer. Ch 4.
provenance.locus: Chapter 4 — Directly-Follows Graph; optimized variant preserves same graph structure as standard DFG

expected.description: Optimized DFG on the noise-free running-example keeps the full 16-edge directly-follows graph: the threshold sweep (fitness_weight=1.0, simplicity_weight=1.0) finds that any pruning breaks perfect trace replay, matching the cited claim that the optimized variant preserves the standard DFG structure (8 activity nodes, 16 edges).
